name: Librero de nichos con puertas abajo
adaptations: the two sliding ribbed doors over the bottom row drawn as three hinged overlay doors with vertical router grooves, one per column; the real piece has one undivided bottom compartment. The sliding version (two leaves over a split door cell) costs one more T18 sheet and brings a sag recommendation on the bottom, which the leg frame no longer holds under each divider
Original may be solid or veneered wood; written in T18 plywood.
Wall anchoring assumed (wallMounted) to satisfy the tipping check; not visible in photos.
Finish is a natural clear oil/wax look: danish-oil is the closest id.
a finger notch is drawn on every door as its way to open; how the sliding doors of the piece are pulled is not recorded
notes: Librero de tres columnas y cuatro filas de nichos abiertos y sin trasera, sobre un cuerpo bajo cerrado, con patas cónicas inclinadas. En Knotty queda con tres puertas abatibles ranuradas abajo, una por columna, con muesca para jalar; la pieza original lleva dos corredizas. Anclado al muro.
